result: No blocking finding in the reviewed delta
scope: Independent read-only source/test review of timer-owner2 admission and controller/descriptor dispatch identity; selected saved full ASM and data reviewed. No exhaustive re-audit of every pre-existing classification branch.
independentChecks: All four frozen source/test hashes match the author report.
All 41 runtime pin arrays, totaling 6301 bytes, independently match the original PE with SHA256 9002b2de6a1f91a790bd0673de125d1cf833f7942bfec827cdcf6ba64d5849ed.

4335D0 sets ECX=2 and tail-calls157130, which ORs that mask into ABB854.1570F0 and1571B0 return without clock advancement while the mask is nonzero.154700 continues its two other frame counters after the clock call.

404A30/4150D0 forward actor RDX to3A8980, which reads actor+3520 and forwards to3FD690.3FD690 calls3B2340. The latter invokes controller+16 and conditionally+24, and invokes the actor descriptor input predicate+120.
Saved vtable data agrees with descriptor update offsets+24 and FIELD_COMMAND callbacks+16/+24. Product code checks the live pointers and code pins before allowing a known classification.

The admission delta ignores only scriptClockOwner2 in addition to the existing trainer-owned clock bit. Active event, pause menu, suspended field, input lock, other clock-owner bits and trainer pause/freeze remain independently classified.

Tests exercise all three supported roles, every other clock-owner bit, combined trainer ownership, active-event/menu/input/field blockers, changed or unreadable vtables and pin drift. Synthetic leaf execution stays within its fixture allocation.

authorTests.attribution: Author reported; reviewer did not build or execute these suites.

limitations: This is a post-update classifier, not an assertion that every possible player action succeeds.
No live-game observation was performed. Modded callbacks outside the pinned identity are conservatively unknown.
This review does not relax active-event or other timer-owner restrictions and does not classify arbitrary event assets.
No product file, existing report, evidence file or package was changed by this review.
